name: Postman MCP Server
summary: Official Postman MCP server connecting agents to Postman collections, workspaces, environments and API specs; remote (OAuth) or local via npx.
description: Tool configurations: **Minimal** (default, essential operations), **Code** (generate client code from public and internal API definitions), **Full** (100+ Postman API tools) and **Learn** (search Postman docs). Remote: `https://mcp.postman.com/minimal` (change to `/code` or `/mcp` for Code or Full) with OAuth per the MCP authorization spec; an EU remote server and the local server (`npx @postman/postman-mcp-server`, `--code`/`--full`) use a Postman API key.

agent_access.notes: OAuth on the US remote server; EU remote and local server take a Postman API key (Authorization: Bearer <key> or POSTMAN_API_KEY). Paths: /minimal, /code, /mcp (full).
